codely.enableCodeLens.description: Show CodeLens annotations above each function with cyclomatic complexity, depth, side effects, and detected patterns.

codely.enableDiagnostics.description: Show Codely findings (deep nesting, high complexity, nested loops, side effects) in the Problems panel.

codely.enableStatusBar.description: Show file-level fatigue score in the status bar.

codely.mode.description: Report depth: standard (concise), deep (full suggestions & structure list), refactor (more refactor hints), architect (module-boundary focus).

codely.analyzeWhileTyping.description: When false, Codely refreshes on save/open/switch tab only (lighter while editing).

codely.gitCompareRef.description: Git ref passed to `git diff` for “Analyze Git Changes” (working tree + staged vs this ref).

codely.language.description: Preferred language for Codely reports and suggestions.
